panels.description: Perp + spot. This is the number that says whether the book is hedged; neither leg alone does. Sustained non-zero means directional exposure that is not being paid for.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", instrument AS metric, (data->>'delta_usd')::float8 AS value FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = ${setup:sqlstring} AND instrument IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Net delta by instrument (USD)

panels.description: abs(perp notional) x annualised funding on the short leg. The spot leg pays nothing, which is the point of this structure - so this is gross carry before fees and borrow.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", instrument AS metric, (data->>'carry_ann_usd')::float8 AS value FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = ${setup:sqlstring} AND instrument IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Carry income, annualised (USD)

panels.description: Cross-venue carries do NOT net margin: Hyperliquid collateral cannot support the Binance leg or the reverse. A sharp move can margin-call one venue while the offsetting profit is stranded on the other, so each venue's headroom is watched separately.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", exchange || ' free' AS metric, (data->>'free')::float8 AS value FROM carry_venue_time WHERE setup = ${setup:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Venue collateral

panels.description: Portfolio Margin health. Healthy above ~1.2; liquidation begins around 1.05. Only meaningful for the Binance leg - Hyperliquid margin is tracked as free collateral instead.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", 'uniMMR' AS metric, (data->>'uni_mmr')::float8 AS value FROM carry_venue_time WHERE setup = ${setup:sqlstring} AND exchange = 'binance' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Binance uniMMR

panels.description: This row is REPEATED per instrument. Adding an instrument to CARRY_INSTRUMENTS makes it appear here with no dashboard edit - which is the whole reason the schema carries instrument as a column rather than a key inside a JSON blob.
panels.title: $instrument

panels.description: Perp and spot notional side by side, with net delta. A healthy carry shows the two legs mirrored and delta flat near zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", 'perp' AS metric, (data->>'perp_usd')::float8 AS value FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = ${setup:sqlstring} AND instrument IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT time, 'spot', (data->>'spot_usd')::float8 FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = ${setup:sqlstring} AND instrument IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT time, 'delta', (data->>'delta_usd')::float8 FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = ${setup:sqlstring} AND instrument IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $instrument legs (USD)

panels.description:
The perp leg's notional against the target configured for it (CARRY_TARGETS; negative = short perp, long spot). The two lines should sit on top of each other.

This asks whether the strategy holds the size it was told to hold, which is NOT the same question as whether it is hedged. A leg that fills to target while its opposite leg fails leaves this panel looking perfect - that is exactly what an inverted target did, with the perp at target and no hedge behind it. Net exposure is on the legs panel above; read the two together.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", 'perp notional' AS metric, (data->>'perp_usd')::float8 AS value FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = ${setup:sqlstring} AND instrument IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT time, 'target', (data->>'target_usd')::float8 FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = ${setup:sqlstring} AND instrument IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $instrument perp notional vs target

panels.description: Funding is what the carry earns. Basis is HL mark vs Binance spot - a widening basis means the two legs are marked against drifting references, so a flat delta is less flat than it looks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", 'funding ann %' AS metric, (data->>'funding_rate_ann')::float8 * 100 AS value FROM carry_leg_time WHERE setup = ${setup:sqlstring} AND instrument IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND leg = 'perp' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT time, 'basis bps', (data->>'basis_bps')::float8 FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = ${setup:sqlstring} AND instrument IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $instrument funding (annualised %) and basis (bps)
Position truth: engine vs this monitor
Engine vs venue disagreement (USD)
panels.description:
The venue position this monitor read, minus the position the trading engine reports holding, per leg, in USD.

This is the genuinely independent check. The two numbers travel completely different paths: the engine over its own websocket with the trading key, this process over REST with a read-only key. Nothing shared, so agreement means something.

It is here because the engine's own local-vs-remote comparison cannot do this. The connectors set Force=true, which makes the engine overwrite its fill-derived tally with the venue's number every sync - so that panel compares one source against itself and a gap can never persist.

Flat zero is the healthy state. A step means the engine's view of a venue has gone stale or wrong, and the strategy sizes from that view, so it would be trading against a position that does not exist. Gaps in the line are honest: they mean the engine's view could not be read, not that the two agreed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", instrument || ' ' || exchange || ' ' || leg AS metric, (data->>'engine_diff_usd')::float8 AS value FROM carry_leg_time WHERE setup = ${setup:sqlstring} AND instrument IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND data->>'engine_diff_usd' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time
